record.name: Signed-account funded allocation
record.summary: Pay one real prefunded reward allocation to a consenting account after qualifying actual swap input.

units.amounts: Explicit per-field raw currency units; no currency/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual v4 liquidity L, not token balances or dollar depth
units.time: Fields distinguish absolute UTC seconds, durations, block counts and Monday UTC weekly offsets
units.identity: Callback sender is usually a router; signatures/NFTs do not imply human diversity

fields.name: minimumExecutedInput

fields.units: raw qualifying input asset units; token decimals are not converted

fields.name: allocationAmount
fields.label: Allocation Amount
fields.units: raw reward token units; token decimals are not converted
